findings.reader: A well-bounded news explainer: it dates the announcement, cleanly separates Chat, Work/Codex and API billing, defines API, workspace and model picker at first use, keeps provider claims attributed and uncertain, and ends with a concrete, proportionate account check. No failure families present; the mechanism transfers to unseen situations.
findings.facts: All material claims check out against the supplied OpenAI release and release-notes excerpts: Work/Codex placement separate from Chat, per-token API pricing distinct from subscription billing, the plan/workspace settings boundary, and Sol's attributed task positioning. Dates, limits and uncertainty are preserved; the sole omission (Free/Go desktop access to Luna) is non-contradictory.
